commitments.title: NDC 3.0 (2025)
commitments.detail: GHG cuts of 29% by 2030 and 32% by 2035 relative to 2018 levels; net zero by 2060; pledges to reduce deforestation by 60% and plant 20 million trees annually; unveiled at the UNGA Climate Ambition Summit, Sept 2025
commitments.source: UNDP Nigeria blog, 15 Oct 2025; Climate Change Laws of the World record

commitments.title: National REDD+ Forest Reference Emission Level (2026)
commitments.detail: National FREL submitted 9 Jan 2026 (modified 30 May 2026) covering deforestation and forest degradation; reference period 2017-2021; 58,610,840 t CO2e/yr; forest definition 0.5 ha, 3 m, 15% canopy; technical assessment report FCCC/TAR/2026/NGA dated 8 Sep 2026
commitments.source: UNFCCC Technical Assessment Report TAR 2026 NGA

commitments.title: Subnational REDD+ FREL, Cross River State (2018)
commitments.detail: Submitted 8 Jan 2018 (modified 28 May 2018); deforestation only; reference period 2000-2014; 8,922,467.1 t CO2e/yr over 20,156 km2
commitments.source: UNFCCC Technical Assessment Report TAR 2018 NGA

commitments.title: Great Green Wall Nigeria (NAGGW)
commitments.detail: National Agency for the Great Green Wall established 2015; 11 frontline states (Adamawa, Bauchi, Borno, Gombe, Jigawa, Kano, Katsina, Kebbi, Sokoto, Yobe, Zamfara); planned 1,500 km greenbelt; 300 km shelterbelt established in 2020
commitments.source: HumAngle Media, 'Great Green Wall: A glance at Nigeria's line of defence against the Sahara'

commitments.title: AFR100 / Bonn Challenge restoration pledge
commitments.detail: 4 million ha of degraded land committed to restoration; linked to land degradation neutrality by 2030 (SDG 15.3)

commitments.title: National Biodiversity Strategy and Action Plan aligned with Kunming-Montreal GBF
commitments.detail: Updated NBSAP with 23 national targets mapped to the KMGBF, including protected-area expansion; no explicit 30x30 percentage found in the sources consulted

commitments.title: National Forest Policy targets (2006)
commitments.detail: Maintain 20-25% of land under forest cover; increase area under sustainable forest management to 25% of national land area (no target year)
